stemMarkdown: A bag contains 5 red balls and 2 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are red? (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Choose 2 from the 5 red balls out of 2 from all 7: $\dfrac{\binom{5}{2}}{\binom{7}{2}} = \dfrac{10}{21} = 0.47619$.
